Yggdrasil.hypothesis: F124-AD anchor=10 readout improves 10-12 hops but may not transfer to 13-15 or dense extended graphs; compare unchanged 10 anchor and AB anchor16 on fresh distinct long cohorts, no FIT tuning.

Wingless.hypothesis: One-state 12-bit packed compression survives in original AA form; failures are partly threshold calibration rather than insufficient per-node slots or proposed 4-bit fingerprint.
Wingless.model: Exact frozen AA one-state packed 12bit code and unchanged weights, only final decision threshold logit+bias. No expanded state, raw fingerprint, cache, or path alternatives.
Wingless.selection: FIT only 48 new pairs, maximize paired exact then minimize absolute bias and favor zero; evaluate DEV only once, no DEV tuning
